movies.title: 25Th Hour
movies.description: Academy Award nominee Edward Norton ( American History X ) heads an amazing all-star cast in this critically acclaimed film by Spike Lee ( Do the Right Thing , Summer of Sam ) recognized for its compassionate view of post-9/11 New York City. In 24 short hours, Monty Brogan (Norton) goes to prison for seven long years. Once a king of Manhattan, Monty is about to say goodbye to the life he knew—a life that opened doors to New York's swankiest clubs but also alienated him from the people closest to him. In his last day on the outside, Monty tries to reconnect with his father (Brian Cox), and gets together with two old friends, Jacob (Philip Seymour Hoffman) and Slaughtery (Barry Pepper). And then there's his girlfriend, Naturelle (Rosario Dawson), who might (or might not) have been the one who tipped off the cops. Monty's not sure of much these days, but with time running out, there are choices to be made as he struggles to redeem himself in the 25th hour.

movies.title: A Litany for Survival: The Life and Work of Audre Lorde
movies.description: This epic portrait of the award-winning Black lesbian poet, mother, teacher, and activist Audre Lorde catalogs an incredibly impactful, revolutionary career. From her childhood roots in Harlem to her battle with breast cancer, the film explores a life, and a body of work, that bridged the Civil Rights movement, the women’s movement, and the struggle for lesbian and gay rights. New restoration premier; Q&A to follow with Ada Gay Griffin, Michelle Parkerson & J.T. Takagi

movies.title: Amazing Grace
movies.description: Captured over two transcendent nights in 1972, Amazing Grace brings Aretha Franklin home to the New Temple Missionary Baptist Church in Los Angeles for a legendary gospel performance. With the congregation singing, swaying, clapping, and testifying alongside her, Franklin transforms the church into a space of collective release and ecstatic communion. The film’s intimacy—its sweat, tears, and sheer physical presence—makes music feel less like something performed than something lived. Directed by Sydney Pollack and finally released decades after it was shot, Amazing Grace is a testament to an artist of earth-shaking talent, and a celebration of Black musical and spiritual traditions as a source of joy and collective power. All hail the Queen of Soul.

movies.title: Amreeka
movies.description: The debut feature film by New York-based Palestinian-American director Cherien Dabis, nominated for an Emmy for her work on Only Murders in the Building , tells the story of Muna Farah (Nisreen Faour), a Palestinian divorcée who wins a green card lottery and moves to rural Illinois with her teenage son, Fadi (Melkar Muallem). Anticipating a better life, mother and son arrive at the beginning of the US invasion of Iraq, and have to learn how to deal with a new land, assimilated relatives, and life as an Arab immigrant in post-9/11 America.

movies.title: Angel Heart
movies.description:
Private investigator Harry Angel (Mickey Rourke) is hired by the mysterious Louis Cyphre (Robert De Niro) to track down legendary singer Johnny Favorite. When everyone he questions turns up dead, Angel learns of Favorite's connection to the dark arts and begins to wonder if his benefactor is hiding his true identity.
4k DCP courtesy of Rialto Pictures.

movies.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore
movies.description:
The epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga returns to theaters as AVENGERS ENDGAME: Encore on September 25, 2026. 
After devastating events wiped out half the world’s population, the remaining heroes struggle to move forward. Ultimately, they must come together to restore order and harmony in the universe and bring their loved ones back in a dramatic showdown against Thanos.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
movies.cast: Robert Downey Jr., Pedro Pascal, Chris Hemsworth, Vanessa Kirby, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Simu Liu, Florence Pugh
movies.description: Universes collide and the Multiverse Saga begins its final chapter in Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and ultimately face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered. This epic film will lay the foundation for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. See it in Infinity Vision, the way it's meant to be seen, on bigger, brighter, and more immersive screens.

movies.title: Babylon
movies.description: Franco Rosso's incendiary Babylon had its world premiere at Cannes in 1980, but went unreleased in the US on account of being “too controversial, and likely to incite racial tension" ( Time Out ). The film follows a young dancehall DJ in South London as he pursues his musical ambitions but seems to experience racism and xenophobia at every turn. Set to a sizzling reggae and lover’s rock soundtrack, Babylon is unapologetically raw and unsentimental, but also tempered by the hazy bliss of the dancehall, where one can release the heat of daily indignities, and music becomes both refuge and resistance. A landmark of Black British cinema, Babylon is a furious, sensual portrait of cultural survival under systemic oppression.

movies.title: Bacurau
movies.description: Out in the blistering Brazilian sertão, the tiny town of Bacurau has bigger problems than heat, water shortages, and a mayor who treats his constituents like garbage. After their beloved matriarch dies, the villagers discover their home has vanished from the map… and yet some very strange and vaguely threatening tourists have descended upon the town-that-was. What starts as a sun-baked mystery curdles into a blood-soaked saga of colonialism and its consequences, class warfare, and collective revenge. Kleber Mendonça Filho ( Neighboring Sounds , Aquarius ) delivers a daring work of sociopolitical commentary, winning the Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival, in this gloriously weird genre mash-up that serves as a critique of contemporary Brazilian society.

movies.title: Basic Instinct
movies.description: The power duo of provocateur director Paul Verhoeven (ROBOCOP) and sleaze-loving writer Joe Eszterhas (FLASHDANCE) made two of the most controversial, infamous movies of the '90s with BASIC INSTINCT and SHOWGIRLS. More than just the nudity and violence it’s remembered for, BASIC INSTINCT finds Verhoeven at his peak power, crafting one of the best erotic thrillers of all time. Eszterhas’ script about a bisexual femme fatale murder suspect is turned by Verhoeven into a complex examination of sex, power, and misogyny as he smuggles his ideas underneath a veneer of sleaze so thick the studio demanded cuts to the over-the-top sex and violence, and LGBTQ groups who viewed the film as promoting negative stereotypes protested its very release. This movie is a Rorschach blot, and every audience will read something different in it, but one thing we all can agree on is the power of Sharon Stone’s performance. Fearless and crackling, she becomes the living embodiment – the cinematic ideal – of a femme fatale. (Laird Jimenez)

movies.title: Bell, Book And Candle
movies.description: A modern-day witch (Novak), charmed by her handsome upstairs neighbor (Stewart), casts a love spell to guarantee his infatuation. But when unexpected feelings emerge, the two neighbors find themselves united by not only the witch’s otherworldly abilities, but also by a power of this world: love. Featuring cinematography from James Wong Howe, this supernatural screwball comedy flits through frosty images of Greenwich Village in a riotous, surprisingly New York-coded reunion of two of the ‘50s most dynamic icons.

movies.title: Breaking Bad Day
movies.description: September 7 is Breaking Bad Day, so we're celebrating the only way that makes sense: with a one-night-only interactive screening of Breaking Bad's legendary Season 4 finale, "Face Off." Admission is free with the purchase of a fully redeemable and refundable $10 food and beverage voucher. Join a live host in a yellow hazmat suit and collect your themed keepsakes: Hector Salamanca's bell, a Heisenberg hat, blue rock candy, and a Gus Fring half-face mask. Then get ready to experience one of television's greatest episodes with a theater full of fellow fans. Reserve your spot now. Let’s cook.

movies.title: Bullet
movies.cast: Mickey Rourke, Tupac Shakur, Ted Levine, Adrien Brody, John Enos III

movies.title: Burn After Reading
movies.description: A bumbling national security state, where blackly humorous incompetence doesn’t diminish a capacity for extreme violence, is parodied in this late Bush-era satire by Joel and Ethan Coen. Burn After Reading follows recently jobless CIA analyst Osborne Cox (John Malkovich), whose misplaced memoirs are found by gym employees Linda and Chad (Frances McDormand and Brad Pitt) who mistake them for classified government documents and attempt to make a profit. Things predictably go awry in this absurd send-up of US spy culture, also starring George Clooney and Tilda Swinton. “For dark laughs and hurtling narrative momentum this spy caper is their best work since Fargo ,” the Chicago Reader proclaimed.

movies.title: Carmen, Baby
movies.description: Liberated Carmen (Uta Leak) becomes an object of obsession for naive policeman Jose (Claus Ringer) in swinging 60s Spain. As Carmen unashamedly sleeps her way to the top in order to get what she wants, Jose’s jealousy leads to his undoing. Taking Prosper Mérimée’s classic novella CARMEN and updating it to the swinging ‘60s, Radley Metzger’s CARMEN, BABY is a fascinating (and rarely-screened) precursor to later classics like CAMILLE 2000 and THE LICKERISH QUARTET. Original 35mm release print courtesy of Harry Guerro

movies.title: Castration Movie Anthology ii. the best of both worlds
movies.description:
CASTRATION MOVIE is a multi-part postmodern epic by visionary auteur Louise Weard.
Circle (Lex Walton) tries to leave a trans separatist cult in New York.
CASTRATION MOVIE ANTHOLOGY ii. THE BEST OF BOTH WORLDS was shot entirely on location in New York City and features a cast headlined by Lex Walton (POMP AND CIRCUMSTANCE), Ivy Wolk (ANORA), Lea Rose Sebastianis (IN A VIOLENT NATURE), Jack Haven (I SAW THE TV GLOW), Hesse Deni (BRAIN DEATH), Theda Hammel (STRESS POSITIONS), Alexandra McVicker (THE SERPENT'S SKIN), Betsey Brown (ACTORS), and Peter Vack (WWW.RACHELORMONT.COM), amongst a mix of other emerging talent and weird and wonderful cameos.

movies.title: Cat People
movies.description: Irena Dubrovna, a Serbian-born fashion illustrator, lives her New York City life under the shadow of a secret: a steadfast belief (and fear) that an ancient curse will render her a terrifying feline predator if she engages in physical intimacy. When she suspects her husband’s infidelity, she taps into her catlike instinct, stalking the alleged mistress. Eschewing the canned effects of earlier monster movies in favor of subtle shadowplay and creative audio cues, Tourneur’s noir investigation of the taboo spurred a frenzy upon its release—and elevated the stature of the horror genre.

movies.title: Caught By The Tides
movies.description: Composed of footage shot over 22 years, Jia Zhang-ke’s Caught by the Tides is a stylistic departure for the filmmaker, invoking impressionistic vignettes and a non-linear melding of fiction and reality. A working class woman (Zhao Tao) sets out to find her lover of years past, after time and circumstance thrust them apart. Moody and unsentimental, the experimental romance serves as dedication to the passage of time, and exploration of how it ebbs and flows with love.

movies.title: City Of Jade
movies.description: A follow up to his documentary Jade Miners , which followed those in the jade mines of Kachin State, Myanmar, City of Jade sees Midi Z turning his camera toward something more personal: his brother, a foreman at the Hpakant jade mine in Kachin State. This unflinching portrayal of the ramifications of back-breaking labor is a moving vision of documentary film-making, thrusting its viewer into the position of a man helpless to relieve his afflicted family.

movies.title: Deathgasm 2: Goremageddon
movies.description: A few years after surviving the last demon apocalypse, Brodie is washed-up, broke, and stuck in small-town purgatory. The long-awaited sequel to Jason Lei Howden's 2015 cult classic promises more gore, more metal, and more head-banging chaos than the original.

movies.title: Deja Vu
movies.description: Assigned to find evidence in the aftermath of an explosion on a New Orleans ferry, ATF agent Doug Carlin (Denzel Washington) is taken to a top-secret government lab that uses experimental time-shifting equipment to identify perpetrators and prevent tragedies. Exploring the themes of surveillance, safety, and loss that define so many films of the era—all the while riffing on Hitchcock’s Vertigo and fatalistic detective stories—Scott and Washington create a quieter, sadder film than one might anticipate from the pulpy concept.

movies.title: Destroy All Monsters
movies.description: The original GODZILLA team of director Ishiro Honda, special-effects supervisor Eiji Tsuburaya, and composer Akira Ifukube reunited for this kaiju extravaganza, which features no fewer than eleven monsters. Set in the remote future of 1999, when the people of Earth have achieved world peace by confining destructive creatures to Monsterland (until an alien race intervenes), DESTROY ALL MONSTERS mounts a thrilling display of innovative action sequences and memorable images that have made it a favorite for generations of viewers.

Now Paul Atreides is an emperor, Chani is back, rebellion is brewing, and the bill for all that power has finally come due. Zendaya caps a truly impressive 2026 in the hugely anticipated finale that demands the biggest screen you can find.

movies.title: Dust Of Angels
movies.description: Two teenagers in a small Taiwanese town spend their days roughing up karaoke joint patrons and getting into nefarious antics, until they stumble on a bag overflowing with guns and drugs. They hightail it to Taipei in pursuit of criminal direction from a gang-affiliated friend. From humble town to sprawling metropolis, Hsiao-ming explores the nation's economic growth in the decade, and how it reverberated through the lifestyles of youth. Lim Giong’s song "A Soundless Place,” would go on to become a hit in Taiwanese pop, and features director Hou Hsiao-hsien as co-performer.

movies.title: Elsinore

movies.description: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

movies.title: Ernie & Emma
movies.description: Who doesn't love Bruce Campbell? After decades battling Deadites and stealing scenes, he’s back with something altogether different. This poignant road-trip comedy–written, directed by, and starring Bruce–follows widowed pear salesman Ernie Tyler as he travels across Oregon to fulfill his late wife's very specific wishes for her ashes. Funny, gently offbeat, and full of heart, it's a reminder that Bruce's greatest superpower has never just been fighting monsters. It's telling a good story.

movies.title: Faust (1926)
movies.description: Mobilizing the full resources of the Ufa Studios, F.W. Murnau (Nosferatu, Sunrise) orchestrated a colossal adaptation of Goethe's FAUST that ranks alongside Fritz Lang's Metropolis as the greatest achievement of the German silent cinema.Gösta Ekman stars as the titular alchemist who, struggling with his faith amidst a devastating plague, is offered the power to cure and the gift of youth...in exchange for his soul. As the diabolical Mephisto, Emil Jannings (The Last Laugh) delivers a performance of operatic scale and intensity, by turns charming, comical, and horrific.This special Kino edition contains the Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau Foundation’s meticulous restoration of the original German version of the film (with unique hand-painted intertitles), as well as a lengthier alternate cut prepared by the Ufa Studios in 1930.

movies.title: First Blood
movies.description: Sylvester Stallone plays Vietnam veteran and occupational vagabond John Rambo, just returned from war. Without a home to call his own, he wanders the streets until arriving at a seemingly unassuming, small logging town. Although the sign at the town entrance reads "Welcome to Hope," there is none to be found in the city limits, only misery and mistreatment from the local law enforcement. When they push Rambo out of town without realizing the consequence of their actions, he comes back with a signature, no-holds-barred brand of retribution. FIRST BLOOD is a brutal critique of America's participation in Vietnam and an all-around action classic. (Sam Prime)

movies.title: Garod Collective Presents: Posthumous Traces
movies.description: Garod Collective presents five short films by Armenian women spanning three decades, exploring themes of family, parenthood, and identity through the lens of loss. These filmmakers depict loss in many forms: from the surreal experience of postpartum depression, to a daughter watching her mother slowly slip away, to a cemetery groundskeeper grieving his own past. Using experimental and conventional narratives, the filmmakers present mythical images of a homeland constantly out of reach, and imagine the lives of fathers they have never known. An exercise in remembering, these works trace intimate threads of connection in danger of fading away. Founded by Cynthia Nahhas and Nanor Vosgueritchian, Garod Collective hosts Armenian cultural events in New York City, acting as a space to introduce, build, or revitalize connections to Armenian culture, language, and tradition. Followed by a Q&A with Anahid Yahjian, director of Domestic Demon Domestic Demon (2026) Dir. Anahid Yahjian 7min; Digital A housebound mother's hunger for agency and control among the mutating textures and temporalities of her home sets off an uncanny transformation in this portrait of matrescence and post-partum depression. World (2020) Dir. Christine Haroutounian 22min; Digital A young woman in the Armenian countryside faces the final days of her mother’s life. Girl From Moush (1994) Dir. Garine Torossian 6min; Digital This poetic montage weaves through a mythical projection of Armenia, part truth and part rendering of the filmmaker’s subconscious vision. General Cleaning (2020) Dir. Naira Sargsyan 26min; Digital An old groundskeeper embarks on a journey of memory and loss as he cleans his village home. Farewell (2004) Dir. Maria Saakyan 27min; Digital In an act of construction and imagining, Saakyan reckons with the loss of a father she never knew, who committed suicide at the age of 21.

movies.title: GHOST IN THE SHELL (SUBTITLED)
movies.description: The mind-melting 1995 anime classic GHOST IN THE SHELL still hits like a cybernetic fist 21 years later. The manga-turned-movie accurately foresaw our 24/7 connected world, and it profoundly impacted sci-fi for decades to come - there would be no THE MATRIX (and so many more) without GHOST IN THE SHELL. When Section 9 agent Motoko Kusanagi is assigned to track down the hacker known as The Puppet Master, what begins as a standard investigation in near-future Japan quickly turns into something more complex, more bizarre and more existentially thrilling. Amidst all the kick-ass anime action there are deep examinations of the nature of gender, the meaning of identity and a vision of a near-future world that is all too close to our own. With gorgeous animation, teeth-rattling action and more ideas and mind-blowing concepts than entire seasons of some TV shows, GHOST IN THE SHELL thrills here, in its original cinematic form.

movies.title: Gridlock’d
movies.cast: Tupac Shakur, Tim Roth, Thandiwe Newton

movies.title: Hausu
movies.description: Partially inspired by Jaws and the eerie suspension conjured by a monster lying in wait, Obayashi’s cult-beloved Hausu is truly impossible to classify. Hypnotic, surreal, and singular, it’s a psychedelic ghost story that feels like a fever dream, following a young girl and her six friends as they visit the former’s ancestral house in the countryside, only to encounter a fiendish house cat, a possessed mirror, a bleeding grandfather clock, and a whole litany of supernatural (and fatal) events. Starring mostly amateur actors, Hausu is a hallucination, part nightmare, part dream come true for fans of the absurd, and just flat-out weird.

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.cast: Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons, Anna Lambe
movies.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, HEART OF THE BEAST is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

movies.title: Hometown Boy
movies.description: In this documentary, director Hung-i Yao turns his lens to one of China’s best-known figurative painters—Liu Xiaodong—as he makes a solemn return to his hometown of Jincheng in North-East China. There, he has a nostalgic goal: to re-paint his community nearly thirty years after he left at the young age of 17. Through its unfiltered portrayal of Liu’s practice, the unadorned doc serves as a portrait of an artist’s ability, and a love letter to the community that shaped him.

movies.title: Hope
movies.cast: Hwang Jung-min, Zo In-sung, Hoyeon, Taylor Russell, Cameron Britton, Alicia Vikander, Michael Fassbender
movies.description: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok (Hwang Jung-min) and officer Sung-ae (Hoyeon) are called to find a mysterious creature that has wreaked havoc on the area. In a forest nearby, a party of hunters including Sung-ki (Zo In-sung) set out to track the beast, only to find themselves hunted instead. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading: what begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through into a tragedy of cosmic proportions. Premiered at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, Hope “races from modern-day western to action thriller to horror film to science-fiction epic—all while retaining the full-throttle energy and sweaty cult-movie atmosphere of a 1970s exploitation flick,” according to the BBC.

movies.title: Island Of Lost Souls + The Island Of Dr. Moreau
movies.description: These two adaptations of H.G. Wells’ enduring 1896 novel The Island of Doctor Moreau were produced over 60 years apart. Each brings its own distinctly spicy flavor to this profoundly unhinged tale of a shipwrecked man left on the island of a mad scientist whose forced, violent experiments on living creatures great and small has created a population of grotesque human-animal hybrids. With its jungle heat, laboratories of pain, and unforgettable chorus of “beast people,” Wells’ novel and its adaptations question our binary understanding of man and beast, civilization and savagery in a bleak and haunting portrayal of genius pushed to extreme cruelty. Island of Lost Souls (1932) Dir. Erle C. Kenton With Charles Laughton, Richard Arlen, Leila Hyams, Bela Lugosi, Kathleen Burke 71min; DCP The first American adaptation of H.G. Wells’ novel (itself preceded by French and German silent films), Kenton’s full-tilt, Pre-Code interpretation of Wells’ Island of Dr. Moreau captures both the disturbing, provocative horror and affecting pathos of the novel, and is still viewed by many as the quintessential adaptation. The Island of Dr. Moreau (1996) Dirs. Richard Stanley & John Frankenheimer With Marlon Brando, Val Kilmer, David Thewlis, Fairuza Balk, Ron Perlman 95min; 35mm Released on the 100th anniversary of the novel’s initial debut, this star-studded contemporary adaptation was notoriously plagued by a litany of issues during its production. The completed film, while heavy and shambolic, also crackles with the genuine chaos that went into its creation, making it a fitting foil to its predecessor.

movies.title: Jesus Camp
movies.description: Directed by Heidi Ewing and Rachel Grady ( The Boys of Baraka ), this revealing documentary follows three devout young Christians attending Pastor Becky Fischer’s Kids on Fire School of Ministry summer camp in Devil’s Lake, ND, where children as young as six years old are taught to become dedicated Christian soldiers in “God’s Army.” In a key portrait of the ascendant religious right culture under the born-again Christian George W. Bush, the children are schooled in how to “take back America for Christ,” and trained to become a part of the country’s political future.

movies.title: Jinpa
movies.description: Stoic truck driver Jinpa picks up a vengeful hitchhiker in the desolate Kekexili plateau, aghast when he hears the young man’s intent to avenge the murder of his father a decade prior. After they part ways, Jinpa finds himself overcome with regret, setting out to find the drifter in an attempt to end the cycle of violence. Named for the Tibetan word meaning “generosity,” Jinpa won Best Screenplay in the Horizons section at the Venice Film Festival in 2018.

movies.title: Ju-On: The Curse
movies.description: Screening in Japanese with English subtitles.Welcome to the J-horror movie that fueled a million night terrors. Before JU-ON: THE GRUDGE, there was JU-ON: THE CURSE—the Y2K analog horror experiment that was written and directed by JU-ON franchise creator Takashi Shimizu under the guidance of Kiyoshi Kurosawa (PULSE). The story follows the present-day tenants of a cursed home as they uncover the secrets of Kayako, a vengeful ghost who would soon become one of Japan’s biggest horror icons. Filmed on lo-fi video cameras and never screened in U.S. theaters, JU-ON: THE CURSE is a minimalist exploration of liminal dread that doubles as a cozy, late-summer campfire tale.

movies.title: Juice
movies.cast: Omar Epps, Tupac Shakur, Jermaine Hopkins, Khalil Kain, Samuel L. Jackson, Queen Latifah

movies.title: Kaili Blues
movies.description: Chen Sheng, an ex-convict turned doctor in the rural community of Kaili, sets out for Zhenyuan to find his nephew, neglected by a careless half brother. There he encounters fragments of his past and present in a tapestry of melancholy and jubilation. In a striking directorial debut, Bi Gan examines ordinary life, extracting magnificent performances from a cast of mostly non-professional actors, including his uncle (and former gangster) Chen Yongzhong.

movies.title: Kiki’S Delivery Service
movies.description: A young, overeager witch—tasked with a mandatory year of independent life—relocates to a port city with her cat, where she starts a flying courier service. The wind rustles through grass against a pale blue sky, steamed buns perspire in hot bakeries, and Kiki soars to new heights as the master of Japanese animation invokes an otherworldly protagonist to exalt the minutiae of this world’s ordinary life. Nestled amid the high-flying antics and witchy witticisms is the film’s beating heart: a meditation on the mischief of youth, the daunting summit of finding one’s purpose, and the delicious possibility offered by nascent curiosity.

movies.title: Klara and the Sun
movies.cast: Jenna Ortega, Amy Adams, Mia Tharia, Aran Murphy, Steve Buscemi, Natasha Lyonne

movies.title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
Kuroneko
movies.description: In feudal Japan, two women are violently murdered by soldiers during a civil war, their bodies tossed aside and pawed at by a black cat. Their deaths spur something ominous: samurai returning from the war found with their throats torn out. The governor tasks a samurai with investigating the macabre murders, leading him down a mystifying path towards the otherworldly entity responsible. Desire, grief, and vengeance collide in Kaneto Shindō’s ( Onibaba , The Naked Island ) atmospheric supernatural thriller, where the boundaries between the living and the dead begin to blur. Shot in striking black and white, Kuroneko turns its shadowy forests and moonlit interiors into an eerie world of beauty and menace.

movies.description: From Cannes-winning directors Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi — popularly known as Los Javis —LA BOLA NEGRA follows three generations of men across pivotal moments in Spanish history, bound by pain, desire, and love. Carlos (Milo Quifes) longs to belong in a fractured Spain. Sebastián (Guitarricadelafuente) finds connection across enemy lines. And Alberto (Carlos González) uncovers a long-buried family secret — one that finally gives voice to truths the past tried to erase.

movies.title: Land Of The Dead
movies.description: In the fourth installment of Romero’s legendary Dead series, the zombies have finally taken over the planet. All that’s left for humanity are isolated city-states, where the rich maintain a strict social hierarchy. Romero, who long used his zombie stories as a site of social critique, fashions the authoritarian leader Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) into an explicit George W. Bush analog when he yells “I don't negotiate with terrorists!”

movies.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
movies.description:
After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, Linkin Park's remaining members struggle to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members, spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention.

Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive From Zero album release and concert in São Paulo, the film UNSHATTER weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans – capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

movies.title: Millennium Mambo
movies.description: Shu Qi ( The Assassin ) portrays Vicky, an aimless bar hostess caught between a possessive boyfriend (Duan Chun-hao) and a sensitive gangster (Jack Kao), in this stylish, seductive submersion into the techno-scored neon nightlife of Taipei directed by Hou Hsiao-hsien—named “one of the three directors most crucial to the future of cinema” in a worldwide poll conducted by the New York Film Festival in 1998. Looking back from the then near-future of 2011, Vicky envisions her life of 10 years earlier rendered in a transfixing, narcotic haze of techno, slo-mo, and iridescent imagery, along with an inescapable undercurrent of ennui.

movies.title: Mississippi Masala
movies.description: Arguably one of the sexiest movies of the ‘90s, Mira Nair’s interracial star-crossed love story is hot in every sense: swampy Southern nights and motel-room dalliances, but also explosive political violence and family tension ready to boil over at any moment. Forced to flee Uganda under dictator Idi Amin and resettle in the US, Mina’s life is turned upside down once again when she begins a passionate—and taboo—love affair with Demetrius, a Black man who shares her dream of a bigger life beyond Greenwood, Mississippi. The languorous atmosphere that hangs over the film is not just about desire, but yearning of another kind: an exile’s need for belonging. Nair’s keen awareness of both the minutiae of relationships and their much broader socio-political context gives the film a depth as key to its enduring popularity as witnessing a shorts-clad Denzel Washington at his face-melting peak.

movies.title: My Brother’S Wedding
movies.cast: Everett Silas, Jessie Holmes, Gaye Shannon-Burnett

movies.title: My Country, My Country
movies.description: Working alone in Iraq over eight months, filmmaker Laura Poitras ( Citizenfour , All the Beauty and the Bloodshed ) creates an extraordinarily intimate portrait of Iraqis living under US occupation. Her principal focus is Dr. Riyadh, an Iraqi medical doctor, father of six and Sunni political candidate. An outspoken critic of the occupation, he is equally passionate about the need to establish democracy in Iraq, arguing that Sunni participation in the January 2005 elections is essential. Yet all around him, Dr. Riyadh sees only chaos, as his waiting room fills each day with patients suffering the physical and mental effects of ever-increasing violence. Nominated for an Academy Award, My Country, My Country is a powerful mosaic of daily life in Iraq.

movies.title: My Sassy Girl
movies.description:
Ignited by what may be the most hilariously disastrous meet-cute in cinema history, MY SASSY GIRL reinvented the romcom with wild aplomb. An unassuming young man’s whole world is turned upside down when a beautiful and ferocious female force of nature takes his life by storm. Their ensuing tumultuous relationship both scales the heights of blockbuster movie fantasies and descends the poignant depths of heartache in this outrageous and uplifting ode to true love.
Based on a South Korean netizen’s blog of reportedly true stories about his girlfriend, the film proved a massive sleeper hit and one of the most influential Asian films of the 21st century. A must-see contemporary classic, MY SASSY GIRL is an “unabashed crowd-pleaser that mixes genres with the audacious abandon that makes Korean cinema so much fun” (Film at Lincoln Center). Presented newly restored in 4K from the original negative.

movies.title: Mystery Transmission
movies.description: Imagine that a local cable station was invaded by otherdimensional creatures at the stroke of midnight. That's Video Vortex. Each month, this series presents a mystery transmission that's culled from the outer limits of home video history – from essential underground films to surreal docs, from tokusatsu battle-parties to outsider experiments. So warm up the cathode tubes, dim the lights, and let your senses intermingle with the glow.

movies.title: Mystery Voyage
movies.description: Exploding out of the AGFA vaults as a brand-new 35mm preservation, this 1990s kung fu fantasia from Hong Kong is a breathtaking combination of action, comedy, and cooking.

movies.title: Nacho Libre
movies.description: Jack Black is at his comic best as Ignacio, a disrespected cook at a Mexican monastery that can barely afford to feed the orphans who live there. Inspired by a local wrestling hero, he decides to moonlight as the not-so-famous Luchador "Nacho Libre" to earn money for the monastery – not to mention the admiration of beautiful nun Sister Encarnacion.

Summoned to an isolated country house, she comes face to face with a grotesque apparition with powers that defy Airi's experience. As she digs deeper into the house's past, a secret comes to light -- and Airi finds herself hunted by a far more unpredictable force. For the first time, her greatest adversary is not the supernatural, but the living.Content expanded.

movies.title: Nightbreed
movies.description:
Welcome to the lost city of Midian. Hope you survive the experience!
Clive Barker followed up the success of his 1987 debut HELLRAISER with NIGHTBREED in 1990, a horror fantasy about the resurrection of a ne'er-do-well (Craig Sheffer) as the messiah of a subterranean society of monsters. The film features many of the trademark Barker touches that made HELLRAISER such a success – the unbridled glee in character design, the use of queer themes in a horror aesthetic (director Alejandro Jodorowsky called the film “the first truly gay horror fantasy epic”), the subversion of religious elements – but NIGHTBREED flopped in its time due to a misguided marketing campaign that foregrounded a serial killer subplot. While this subplot is one of the film's high points as director David Cronenberg camps his way through a role as a masked butcher of families obsessed with hunting the hidden Nightbreed, the true appeal of Barker's sophomore effort lies in the painstakingly conceived grotesquerie of his monsters.

movies.title: Nosferatu (1922)
movies.description: In the town of Wisbourg, estate agent Mr. Knock is pleased to receive a commission from Count Orlok to find a house for him. He dispatches his young assistant, Hutter, to Orlok's castle in the far-off Carpathians. He tells Hutter to get him to buy the vacant house just opposite Hutter's own. Hutter arrives at his destination safely and the Count is all too eager to buy the proposed property, especially after he sees a photo of Hutter's pretty young wife Ellen. Hutter soon realizes the evil he's dealing with and is locked away while Orlock makes his way by ship to Wisbourg. As Orlok travels to Wisbourg, plague descends in his wake and the people of Wisbourg begin to sense the coming of evil. Hutter eventually escapes Orlok's castle, determined to return home as quickly as possible, but exhausted and ill, finds himself in hospital. Hutter nonetheless arrives home the same day as Orlok and the townsfolk begin to panic over the increasing number of deaths.

movies.title: On a String
movies.description: Isabel (Isabel Hagen) is a young, Juilliard-trained violist still living at home with her parents in the heart of New York City. She’s trying to make a living playing gigs with her friends, but when her toxic ex-boyfriend reappears – who also happens to be the Philharmonic's "newest, hottest cellist" – he informs her of a viola opening in the prestigious orchestra. Nothing can go wrong, right?

movies.title: Onda Nova
movies.description:
Presented in Brazilian with English subtitles
São Paulo, 1983: Women’s soccer has just been legalized in Brazil. A group of rebellious young women form the Gayvotas Football Club and begin training for their first match. But as the team quickly becomes a media sensation, its members are forced to confront the prejudices of the conservative military dictatorship that they live under.Banned shortly after its premiere at the 1983 São Paulo International Film Festival and never released outside of Brazil until now, Ícaro Martins and José Antonio Garcia’s ONDA NOVA is a defiantly queer and gleefully anarchic sex comedy that still packs a subversive punch (or kick?) all these years later.4K restoration courtesy of Muscle Distribution

movies.title: Onibaba
movies.description: During a sweltering summer in 14th century Japan, a mother and her daughter-in-law survive by murdering lost samurai and selling their armor for food. That is, until a suitor comes between them. As their relationship unravels in a blaze of lust and distrust, the film’s stark black-and-white cinematography, tense, percussive score, and supernatural liberties push Onibaba into an impressionistic mode of storytelling, one that is erotic, disturbing, and surreal. Bodies thrash through sinister waist-high grass, corpses pile up and begin to rot, and still the air grows thick with desire. Part folk-horror, part social critique, part cinematic rendering of Noh theater, Kaneto Shindō’s pivotal piece of ‘60s Japanese cinema is a feral phantasmagoria that defies easy categorization.

A psychological horror story starring an anatomically correct dummy, written and directed by Sandor Stern, screenwriter of THE AMITYVILLE HORROR (1979), based on the best-selling novel by Andrew Neiderman, and from the executive producer of David Cronenberg’s SCANNERS and VIDEODROME. movies.title: Pink Floyd – The Wall
movies.description: Featuring sparse dialogue and a mesmerizing combination of experimental animation and live action, Alan Parker’s visualization of a landmark album lives in a limbo between music video and narrative film. Tracing the trials and tribulations of rock star Pink, driven to madness by the privilege of stardom and trauma of his upbringing, the kaleidoscopic odyssey is at times horrifying and others jubilant. Pink Floyd — The Wall is the visualized embodiment of the angst reverberating through the rock opera concept album of the same name, which established Pink Floyd as perhaps the distinctive voice in prog rock. Preceded by a special video introduction by Lim Giong

movies.title: Playback: The Brooklyn Watch Party
movies.description: BAM proudly joins forces with two iconic Brooklynites—filmmaker Spike Lee and Clara Wu Tsai, owner of the New York Liberty and the Brooklyn Nets—to present Playback: The Brooklyn Watch Party , a two-day celebration of the artists, storytellers, and communities that have made Brooklyn one of the most culturally influential places in the world. Created by filmmaker and producer Nicholas Ma ( Won’t You Be My Neighbor? , Unfinished Business ) and special guest curators, this inaugural festival includes screenings of repertory films, pop-up activations, a free street fair, and so much more—head to playbackbk.com and sign up to receive updates.

movies.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entaglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

movies.title: Powwow People
movies.description: Powwow People is a vérité-style documentary grounded in the rhythms, relationships, and lived experience of a contemporary Native gathering. Rather than entering as outside observers, the filmmakers organized the powwow itself, inviting dancers, singers, vendors, and community members to participate in the making of this film. Structured around the arc of a single day, the film follows four central figures: Gina Bluebird, who frames the powwow’s shape and guides its setup; Ruben Littlehead, the MC whose presence anchors the present moment; Jamie John, a non-binary dancer imagining the future of these traditions; and Freddie Cozad, a singer and drummer considering the past. The film culminates in a 30-minute unbroken shot of a Northern Traditional dance special, drawing the viewer into the textures, movement, and collective presence of the powwow. It is both a reflection of a beloved community and a gesture toward the continuities of Native life. Q&A with Sky Hopinka following the 7pm screenings on 9/11 and 9/12

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.cast: Nicole Kidman, Sandra Bullock, Cassie Bradley, Lee Pace, Joey King, Maisie Williams, Dianne Wiest, Stockard Channing
movies.description: Twenty-seven years after Sally and Gillian Owens first bewitched us, Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman return with a new generation of family magic and an old curse threatening to unravel it all. The original gave us midnight margaritas, broom mishaps, and Gillian’s eternally enviable wardrobe. Now, the Owens family has another curse to deal with, plus a whole new generation of witches. Bring your whole coven to Alamo Drafthouse and see what kind of trouble the Owens sisters get into this time.

movies.description: Charting the Sheffield band’s extraordinary journey from obscurity to cultural touchstone. Fusing footage from Pulp’s biggest ever arena show – part of the global tour for ‘More’, the band’s first album in 24 years – with four decades of colourful, never-seen-before archival material.

movies.title: Queen At Sea
movies.cast: Juliette Binoche, Tom Courtenay, Lolabelle Backus
movies.description: Amanda (Academy Award winner Juliette Binoche, The English Patient, The Taste of Things) and her stepfather Martin (Academy Award nominee Tom Courtenay, Doctor Zhivago, 45 Years) struggle with a moral issue that divides them. Has Amanda’s mother Leslie (Anna Calder-Marshall) who is suffering from advanced dementia, lost the ability to make critical decisions in her own best interests? And, if so, who is responsible – a spouse, a child, an institution – for making such a determination? As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control.

movies.title: Queen Budapest
movies.description: On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury. Now, this original concert film has been beautifully rescanned and remastered in 4K alongside a dynamic new audio mix, featuring many of Queen's favorite tracks – "Bohemian Rhapsody," "Crazy Little Thing Called Love," "I Want To Break Free," and "We Are The Champions." With three years to go before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this was the first Western rock concert performed in a stadium behind the then-Iron Curtain. It was of such significance to the Hungarian authorities and film industry that a group of the country's top film cameramen and technicians were brought together to film it for posterity.

movies.title: Red Card + Sunrise/Sunset
movies.description: Korean American filmmaker Ougie Pak conjures atmospheric films of emotional heft and quietly beautiful imagery, reflections of an infatuation with the identities of both American coasts. Sunrise/Sunset , Pak’s debut and a BAMcinemaFest selection, is an outsider’s portrait of New York City, reveling in the thrill and dizziness of a Korean man’s tumultuous arrival. In his latest work Red Card , Pak crosses the country, depicting a gang member love story nestled in California’s San Gabriel Valley. Red Card (2023) Dir. Ougie Pak 48min; Digital Pak explores masculinity and control in this neon-lit drama set amongst the diaspora of Los Angeles. At an underground hostess bar in the San Gabriel Valley, CA, a Taiwanese American gang member breaks the cardinal rule of his job when he falls in love with the new star girl of the club. Sunrise/Sunset (2019) Dir. Ougie Pak 47min; Digital After failing his university entrance exams for the third year in a row, Min Suk, a directionless twenty-something Korean man, travels to New York to visit his long-distance girlfriend Yeon Jae. Over the course of a rollercoaster week, he experiences both the thrill of losing himself in a new city and the bitter realization that his relationship is gradually imploding. A romantic, outsider’s view of New York shot in elegiac black and white, Sunrise/Sunset perfectly captures the wonder and disorientation that comes with being a stranger adrift in a strange land.

movies.title: Redacted
movies.description: Written and directed by Brian De Palma ( Carrie , Scarface ), Redacted is a fictionalized account of a real incident in which US soldiers sexually assaulted and killed a teenage girl in Iraq. Partly inspired by reports about the 2006 incident on the Internet, De Palma fashions a faux documentary, interviewing soldiers and Iraqi locals and inventing blogs, video diaries, and online testimonials to relate the brutal story in an unvarnished, immediate manner. One of the director’s most divisive projects, Redacted addresses how atrocities are reported in the age of Abu Ghraib.

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.description: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger ( Weapons , Barbarian ) comes a thrilling reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, a medical courier unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos. Reuniting with Austin Abrams ( Weapons ), Cregger again toes the line between terrifying and ebullient, delivering another entry into the filmography of one of modern horror’s most entertaining auteurs.

movies.title: Resident Evil (2026)

That’s SAW VI—a lean, mean, limb-ripping machine that’s a standout in this beautifully strange and compelling franchise. Like FRIDAY THE 13TH PART VI: JASON LIVES, SAW VI is the final chapter of a complex in-franchise “trilogy” that finds the successor of serial killer Jigsaw continuing the maestro’s legacy of brutality. But can anyone truly escape the ghosts of Jigsaw and his faithful puppet Billy? Remember: “Once you see death up close, then you know what the value of life is.”

movies.title: Star Trek: The Genesis Trilogy
movies.description:
It is 1980. Disappointed with the decidedly un-STAR WARS-like performance of STAR TREK: THE MOTION PICTURE, Paramount executives approach television producer Harve Bennett about taking over the next outing of the Starship Enterprise, but for a far lower budget than the prior film and its special effects extravaganza. 
To familiarize himself with the series, Bennett watched all 79 episodes of the original series, with one story – season one's "Space Seed" – igniting his imagination. The tale of an antiheroic superhuman named Khan who attempts to take over the Enterprise but who is left with his followers on an Earth-like planet to create their own utopia... well, it begged for a follow-up.
Alongside co-writer Jack B. Sowards and young director Nicholas Meyer, Bennett created that follow-up, and set the stage for two more films that, though planned one-by-one, work as a perfect trilogy. A story of sacrifice, of friendship, and of reclaiming your first and best place in the universe...
About STAR TREK II: THE WRATH OF KHAN1982 | 113 mins.
"Commanding a starship is your first best destiny. Anything else is a waste of material."
Not just a great STAR TREK film, not just a great science-fiction film, it’s one of the greatest films of all time. An epic revenge tale that also manages to pack in meditations on aging, regret, and how we deal with death. It’s the finest moment in the entire original series canon.
About STAR TREK III: THE SEARCH FOR SPOCK1984 | 105 mins.
“My father says that you have been my friend. You came back for me.”
Leonard Nimoy stayed with the series to direct this – his first feature and the best of the odd-numbered Treks. The story (literally) inverts the previous film's themes as the Enterprise crew goes renegade to save their friend and heal the afflicted Dr. McCoy.
About STAR TREK IV: THE VOYAGE HOME1986 | 119 mins.
“They like you very much, but they are not the hell 'your' whales.”
When a mysterious alien probe threatens Earth by evaporating the oceans and destroying the atmosphere, there's only one crew that can save the planet: the crew of the late, great NCC-1701, currently fugitives thanks to their activities in Part 3. In a swift attempt to save mankind, Admiral Kirk and his crew must time-travel back to 1986 San Francisco, where they find a world of punk, pizza, and exact-change buses. 
More than "the one with the whales," this rollicking adventure quickly warps away from the heavy themes of the past two films for the most fun STAR TREK ever made, and the wrap-up to the unintended trilogy that began with WRATH OF KHAN.

movies.title: Starstruck
movies.description: An Australian teen who works as a barmaid in her mother’s pub fantasizes about becoming a rock sensation, and intends to make her dreams a reality by getting her family onto the television talent show Starstruck . The mosh-pit collision of Armstrong’s ( My Brilliant Career , Little Women ) sumptuous, painterly aesthetic and the grit of ‘80s working class inner-city Sydney infuses the film with an impish, unruly beauty that is mesmerizing on screen. The lace-and-leather effect of a film so fiercely feminine and chaotically punk is infectious, charming, and utterly original. Starstruck is an ecstatic, roadside-stand-firework of a musical comedy that celebrates the heat of being young, wanting more, and believing you can get it.

The hottest name in NASCAR racing, Ricky Bobby ( Ferrell) has it all—a hot wife, a posh life, and best friend Cal Naughton Jr. (John C. Reilly) as his loyal wingman—until flamboyant French Formula One driver Jean Girard (Sacha Baron Cohen) shows up to take it all away. “ Talladega Nights may be brash, unbridled, even unhinged,” the Wall Street Journal proclaimed, “but its cornpone humor is rich in parody, and its craftsmanship is superb.”

movies.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
movies.description:
Sequels rarely surpass their predecessors. But when TERMINATOR 2: JUDGMENT DAY came roaring into theaters in 1991, audiences were treated to a film that took everything they loved about the first and launched it to a whole new level.
Set years after THE TERMINATOR, Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton) is now in a mental institution, and her son, John (Edward Furlong), the future leader of the human resistance in the war against the machines, is a rebellious teenager. But when the machines send the advanced T-1000 (Robert Patrick) back in time to kill John, Sarah will have to escape and fight for John's protection with the most unlikely ally: a T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), the exact model that tried to kill her before John was born.
As if THE TERMINATOR wasn’t mind-blowing enough, writer/director James Cameron throws even more brain-busting time travel madness at you in TERMINATOR 2: JUDGMENT DAY. And this time, he’s got a way bigger budget, packing the film with then-revolutionary CGI effects, explosive action, and incredible model and puppet work from the legendary Stan Winston, all in service of a powerful film about friendship, family, and what it means to be human.

movies.title: TERROR TUESDAY: THE DEVIL'S DOORWAY
movies.description: You’ve never seen a found footage horror movie quite like this one. Directed and co-written by Aislinn Clarke and shot on beautiful 16mm film, THE DEVIL’S DOORWAY tells the story of two priests as they investigate Satanic occurrences at a monastery. Incorporating the real-life setting of Ireland’s Magdalene Laundries—Catholic institutions that housed “fallen women”—Clarke utilizes the found footage format to explore personal themes of generational trauma and motherhood. Artfully orchestrated and thoroughly chilling, this movie feels like a haunted scrapbook that was never meant to be opened.

movies.title: The Assassin
movies.description: In China during the Tang dynasty, Nie Yinniang (Shu Qi) works as an assassin, directed to slay corrupt government officials by her master. But a mission failed due to her own mercy begets a more ruthless assignment for the stoic killer: to return to her land of birth and kill the man to whom she was betrothed in youth. Netting a Best Director award at Cannes for Hou Hsiao-Hsien and named the best film of 2015 by Sight & Sound , the film marked the master of the Taiwanese New Wave’s final film before retiring in 2023.

movies.title: The Birdcage
movies.description:
Featuring an all-star cast including Gene Hackman, Dianne Wiest, and Hank Azaria, and crafted by the brilliant comedic minds of Mike Nichols and Elaine May, this outrageous farce remains a hilarious and cherished staple of LGBTQIA cinema that has charmed audiences of all backgrounds.
Based on the riotous French play Les Cage Aux Folles, the film follows a gay cabaret owner (Robin Williams) and his drag queen partner (Nathan Lane) who pretend to be straight so that their son can comfortably introduce them to his fiancée’s moralistic parents. The mayhem that follows is as side-splitting as it is touching, resulting in a beautiful reminder that everyone deserves to be their authentic selves.

movies.title: The Black Cat
movies.description: Loosely based on the 1843 Edgar Allan Poe story of the same name, Fulci’s gory, shuddersome horror follows a small English town plagued by a series of violent acts, all orbiting around one central figure: a cat. An early example of the trademark hyper-violence that would net the Italian master of giallo the title of "The Godfather of Gore,” The Black Cat is macabre and slicked with blood, a vivid exercise in style sure to leave you gasping—and looking sideways at feline friends.

movies.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
movies.description:
It is difficult to imagine precisely what cinema would be without its most influential and memorable titles. THE CABINET OF DR. CALIGARI in particular stands out as one such notable title in the international canon that in its time and forever thereafter has been heralded as a masterpiece of its craft, the singular model for expressionist, black-and-white filmmaking.
A landmark of horror filmmaking, its visual style is often copied or paid homage, and its remarkable twist ending has become all but a modern trope. Its long, haunting shadows and canted, dreamlike production design stay with viewers weeks, months, and years following an initial viewing.
The film is credited for introducing the "twist" ending and inspired EDWARD SCISSORHANDS by Tim Burton, THE IMAGINARIUM OF DR. PARNASSUS by Terry Gilliam, and Martin Scorsese's SHUTTER ISLAND, all of which share many striking similarities to CALIGARI.
"The first thing everyone notices and best remembers about THE CABINET OF DR. CALIGARI (1920) is the film's bizarre look. The actors inhabit a jagged landscape of sharp angles and tilted walls and windows, staircases climbing crazy diagonals, trees with spiky leaves, grass that looks like knives. These radical distortions immediately set the film apart from all earlier ones." – Roger Ebert, Chicago Sun-Times

movies.title: The Cassandra Cat
movies.description: In a quiet Czech town, a traveling magician arrives with a beautiful performer and a spectacled cat donning a mysterious pair of sunglasses best left in place. When the shades come off, the feline’s extraordinary vision reveals the hidden nature of everyone it sees, turning the townspeople’s secrets into a riot of color. A key work of the Czechoslovak New Wave, Vojtěch Jasný’s playful fairy-tale allegory combines fantasy, comedy, and sharp social satire, winning both the Special Jury Prize and the C.S.T. Prize at the 1963 Cannes Film Festival.

movies.title: The Cat

Combining silly animal tropes with pet-swapped action movie mainstays, Lam Ngai Kai (best known for the viciously violent martial arts film Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky ) renders an epic cross-species battle that is, at times, nonsensical, but always a blast.

movies.title: The Cat Creeps
movies.description: Journalist Terry Nichols enlists a photographer friend to help solve a murder, only to later rely on the help of a much stranger companion: a black cat suspected to be possessed by the spirit of a deceased woman. Toeing the line between true horror and crime melodrama, Erle Kenton ( The Island of Lost Souls ) creeps from mansion to boat brig to dollhouse, weaving around the corners of a plot in which nothing is truly as it appears.

movies.title: The Cat From Outer Space
movies.description: This whimsical romp follows a tabby from, you guessed it, outer space. When a stranded UFO is impounded by the US government, the suits are surprised (and a bit bemused) to find a cat in its pilot seat, donning a special collar that grants the ability to communicate with humans. Jake the cat (played by Rumpler and Amber, brother and sister Abyssinian cats) must seek the help of a scientist to repair his ship and return home in this underrated, quintessential 1970s Disney comedy.

Made in the wake of the 2001 Patriot Act and the rise of technological mass surveillance, Batman’s path to justice in the film recalls the Bush administration’s violation of civil liberties in the name of safety. One of the highest-grossing films of all time, The Dark Knight established the template for the modern super-hero movie, and earned Ledger posthumous Academy, BAFTA, and Golden Globe awards.

movies.description:
Harry is an old-school hustler. A classic native New Yorker, he moves through life lubricating palms with cash, relying on his wits and connections. But times are changing for Harry. His daily pickpocket take isn’t green bills and wristwatches, it’s credit cards and cell phones. And one unfortunate night, cryptocurrency and a handgun.

The Only Living Pickpocket in New York is a nostalgic portrait of a small-time career criminal navigating today's digitally networked world. Writer/Director Noah Segan's modern metropolis is powered by the ephemera of a time gone by, with shoe-leather action brought to radiant life by a terrific cast, led by John Turturro's exceptional turn as Harry.

Sofía (Mimi Davila) moves in and out of other people’s intimate spaces and quotidian lives, tweaking her personality just enough to connect while struggling to find balance between her professional and personal worlds. movies.description: Wendy (Dakota Fanning) believes she's perfectly happy in her relationship until her older boyfriend, Jack (Jake Johnson), who is divorced with children, insists they take a break to make sure she's truly okay giving up on the idea of marriage and babies. During this time, Wendy unexpectedly runs into her ex, Chuck (Cory Michael Smith), who reignites her carefree and spontaneous side, and suddenly seems to want a family. The three of them navigate a chaotic, confusing, and often funny relationship triangle, reminding us that the pursuit of love is beautiful and messy all at once. The film was shot on 35mm on location in Alaska.

movies.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
movies.description: The supernatural tale of star-crossed lovers continues as the Cullen family flees Forks in order to protect Bella (Kristen Stewart), and the heartbroken high-school senior discovers that vampires aren't the only creatures in town. Realizing that Bella will never be safe as long as he's around, Edward (Robert Pattinson) makes the difficult decision to leave his beloved behind shortly after her 18th birthday. Reeling from her loss, Bella embraces self-destruction after being comforted by Edward's image during a moment of mortal peril. But as heavy-hearted as Bella may be, her friend Jacob (Taylor Lautner) distracts her from her sorrows by helping her renovate a weather-beaten motorbike. When Bella encounters a former adversary with a sizable grudge, she's rescued from harm at the last second by a pack of enormous, ferocious wolves. Subsequently delving into the history of the Quileutes, Bella discovers the secrets of Jacob's tribe while looking forward to a reunion with Edward that may have deadly consequences.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.description: Andrew Garfield leads a brutal, propulsive rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in this medieval war epic from writer-director Paul Greengrass (THE BOURNE SUPREMACY). As England descends into bloodshed, one man rallies an army of ordinary people and takes the fight straight to the crown.

movies.title: The Weight

movies.title: The World
movies.description: The World was inspired by a conversation between director Jia Zhang-ke and star Zhao Tao ( Caught by the Tides ) about the latter’s experience working as a dancer at Shenzhen’s “Window of The World,” a theme park filled with miniature versions of international landmarks. In his first film made with the approval of the Chinese government, Jia explores the role of theme parks in altering contemporary national identity-construction, and blurring the line between reality and fantasy. Following a cast of rural migrants working at the park in the early 20th century, he depicts their experience of faux freedom in a pointed commentary on the implications of globalization.

movies.title: Tongues Untied
movies.description: Intended to “shatter this nation’s brutalizing silence on matters of sexual and racial difference,” Marlon Riggs’ gorgeous, groundbreaking essay film weaves together documentary, performance, poetry, music, and personal testimony into a witnessing and an assertion of Black gay life in America. Made at the height of the AIDS crisis, Tongues Untied generously and defiantly insists on sharing moments of pleasure and tenderness alongside righteous rage and grief. It allows the community and the individuals within it to be witnessed in the fullness of their humanity—a humanity that was so violently denied by mainstream culture that the firestorm of controversy around the film reached Congress, where it was reduced to a talking point in the bitter culture wars and weaponized as an excuse to cut federal funding to the arts. Sensual, playful, confrontational, and formally audacious, Tongues Untied remains a radical and necessary part of the queer cinema canon.

movies.title: Twilight (2008)
movies.description: TWILIGHT is an action-packed, modern-day love story between a teen girl and a vampire. Bella Swan (Kristen Stewart) has always been a bit different, never fitting in with the girls at her school. When Bella is sent to live with her father in the rainy little town of Forks, Washington, she doesn’t expect much to change. Then she meets the mysterious and dazzlingly beautiful Edward Cullen (Robert Pattinson), a boy unlike any she’s ever met. Edward is a vampire, but he doesn’t have fangs and his family is unique in that they choose not to drink human blood. Edward has been waiting 90 years for a soul mate, which he finds in Bella. They are soon swept up in a passionate and unorthodox romance. Edward must struggle to resist the primal pull of her scent, which could send him into an uncontrollable frenzy, but what will they do when a clan of new vampires – James (Cam Gigandet), Laurent (Edi Gathegi), and Victoria (Rachelle Lefevre) – come to town and threaten to disrupt their way of life?

movies.description: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson) lands a seemingly easy ghostwriting job with famous author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway), only to discover that the Crawford family has enough secrets to fill several bestselling thrillers. As she digs deeper into the disturbing autobiographical notes Verity has left behind, the line between fiction and reality starts getting seriously blurry, especially with Verity’s husband Jeremy (Josh Hartnett) in the picture. Based on Colleen Hoover’s bestselling novel and directed by Michael Showalter, VERITY is the kind of glossy, grown-up thriller that knows exactly how much fun it is to go off the rails.

movies.title: War Of The Worlds
movies.description: Tom Cruise packs his oversize screen presence into a human-scale portrayal of Ray Ferrier, a divorced dockworker with weekend custody of his teenage son and young daughter, in Steven Spielberg’s big-budget, high-octane take on the titular 1898 H.G. Wells novel about invaders from outer space. Transposing the action to the modern day, our greatest pop filmmaker mines American anxieties of destruction and invasion that defined the post-9/11 era.

movies.description: A fisherwoman lives on the fringes of a seaside village; she is unmarried, stinky, and constantly teased. One day, sick of her stuffy, narrow-minded neighbors, she orders a wicker husband for herself.

movies.title: Wild Horse Nine
movies.cast: John Malkovich, Sam Rockwell, Steve Buscemi, Mariana di Girolamo, Ailín Salas, Tom Waits, Parker Posey
movies.description: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

movies.description: From writer-director Bassam Tariq, YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

movies.title: 12 Years A Slave
movies.description: 12 Years a Slave is based on an incredible true story of one man’s fight for survival and freedom. In the pre-Civil War United States, Solomon Northup (Chiwetel Ejiofor), a free Black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery. Facing cruelty personified by a malevolent slave owner (Michael Fassbender) as well as unexpected kindnesses, Solomon struggles not only to stay alive, but to retain his dignity. In the twelfth year of his unforgettable odyssey, Solomon's chance meeting with a Canadian abolitionist (Brad Pitt) forever alters his life. The winner of three Academy Awards including Best Picture, 12 Years a Slave returns to BAM screens alongside the new restoration of Gordon Park’s version of the same story, Solomon Northrup’s Odyssey .

movies.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
movies.cast: Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester, and Douglas Rain
